shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app -type f | sort; echo "---page.tsx---"; cat /workspace/app/page.tsx; echo "---layout.tsx---"; cat /workspace/app/layout.tsx; echo "---data.ts---"; cat /workspace/lib/data.ts; echo "---next.config.ts---"; cat /workspace/next.config.ts
ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | head -1; test -d node_modules && echo "node_modules present" || echo "no node_modules"

(npx next start -p 3210 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s -o /tmp/prefetch.html -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %7B%22slug%22%3A%22%22%7D" "http://localhost:3210/projects/acme"; echo "---prefetch body---"; cat /tmp/prefetch.html

time curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3210/projects/acme?_rsc=abc123" -o /tmp/prefetch.rsc; echo "size:"; wc -c /tmp/prefetch.rsc; echo "---content---"; cat /tmp/prefetch.rsc

echo "=== full navigation RSC request (no prefetch header) ==="
time curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %7B%7D" "http://localhost:3210/projects/acme" -o /tmp/full.rsc
wc -c /tmp/full.rsc
echo "--- content ---"
cat /tmp/full.rsc
echo
echo "=== prefetch RSC request ==="
time curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %7B%7D" "http://localhost:3210/projects/acme" -o /tmp/prefetch2.rsc
wc -c /tmp/prefetch2.rsc
echo "--- content ---"
cat /tmp/prefetch2.rsc
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo done
